# Quality Gates

*Generated from `openup-config.yml`. Edit the source, not this file.*

Every condition below is a named predicate implemented in `evaluate_gate.py`, from which these descriptions are taken. A gate passes only if all of its conditions pass; absence of evidence fails a condition rather than skipping it.

```bash
python3 .specify/extensions/openup/scripts/python/evaluate_gate.py --gate GATE-LIFECYCLE_ARCHITECTURE --json
```

## GATE-LIFECYCLE_OBJECTIVES

Phase: **INCEPTION**

| Condition | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `vision_present` | A vision document exists (.specify/lifecycle/vision.md). |
| `stakeholders_identified` | A stakeholder document exists, naming who approves what. |
| `initial_risks_registered` | The risk register is not empty. |
| `wbs_levels_1_to_3_valid` | The WBS skeleton exists (Program, Phase, Iteration) and passes WBS-001..003. |
| `requirements_have_owners` | Every registered requirement names an owner. |

## GATE-LIFECYCLE_ARCHITECTURE

Phase: **ELABORATION**

| Condition | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `architecture_baselined` | An architecture document exists and every registered ADR is APPROVED or beyond. |
| `all_high_risks_have_mitigation` | Every high-exposure risk has mitigation work and a verification reference (RISK-004, RISK-005). |
| `requirements_traceable` | Every requirement is both implemented and verified (TRC-005, TRC-006). |
| `critical_contracts_defined` | At least one CONTRACT-* artifact is registered and its declared source file exists. NOTE: the OpenAPI/AsyncAPI document itself is never parsed. |
| `security_review_complete` | A security review record exists and its status is 'passed'. A missing record FAILS. |
| `wbs_valid` | validate_wbs.py reports no FAIL. |
| `human_approvals_witnessed` | Every approval names someone the approval matrix records, and the matrix names somebody. Signature verification of a declared commit is APV-002. |

## GATE-INITIAL_OPERATIONAL_CAPABILITY

Phase: **CONSTRUCTION**

| Condition | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `wbs_valid` | validate_wbs.py reports no FAIL. |
| `forward_coverage_met` | Requirement-to-implementation coverage meets its configured threshold. |
| `backward_coverage_met` | Every in-perimeter source file is reachable from a requirement. |
| `acceptance_scenarios_passing` | An acceptance test record exists with at least one scenario and zero failures. |
| `definition_of_done_met` | Every WBS node marked done survives the Definition of Done: evidence resolves, linked requirements are implemented and verified, acceptance criteria have scenarios, mitigated risks were reassessed with evidence. |
| `no_open_critical_risks` | No risk at or above the critical exposure threshold is still open. |
| `no_orphans` | No orphan artifacts (s54). |

## GATE-PRODUCT_RELEASE

Phase: **TRANSITION**

| Condition | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `all_gates_passed` | Every prior (non-TRANSITION) gate in openup-config.yml passes. |
| `release_evidence_complete` | All four release documents are present: release-readiness, deployment-plan, operations, acceptance-report. |
| `no_open_high_risks` | No risk at or above the high exposure threshold is still open. |
| `traceability_final` | validate_trace.py reports no FAIL, AND at least half of all edges are independently verifiable — reproduced by a derivation rule, or approved with a signature that still matches its endpoints. |
| `security_validation_passed` | A security validation record exists, passed, with zero critical findings. |
| `human_approvals_witnessed` | Every approval names someone the approval matrix records, and the matrix names somebody. Signature verification of a declared commit is APV-002. |
